_comment: Downloader X reads this file. Edit it, run  python deploy.py  then push repo/ to github.com/lyrasoftt/downloader-x . Every installed copy picks up the change on its next start - no new build.
_moved_to: To move every installed copy to a new address, add  "moved_to": "https://new-address"  while this address still answers, then sign and push. The app follows it once and remembers it.
